title: Port weatherScore and bandFor with tests
description:
js/weatherScore.js: weatherScore({highC, lowC, cloudPct, popPct, visKm}) as an exact port of CALCULATE_WEATHER_SCORE_ (Infinity when highC >= 30 or <= 5; else round((pop*2 + cloud)^2 + 2^(vis/30)) / 100). bandFor(score) maps to good / fair / poor / nogo using config.BANDS.

Acceptance: tests cover the Infinity edges (5, 30), a clear day, a rainy day and each band boundary.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, sections "Components > weatherScore", "Data > Weather bands".
